answer: Each claim must send a sparrow along a path built only from its own verified jobs, landing on a lotus that blooms at the ledger line set by the last close hash. Three peers read the ripple the flight leaves: a copied claim's sparrow never flew, so it leaves no ripple and the claim drops with its 110 POA fee burned. Each flight consumes five of the claimant's verified jobs as fuel, and one job fuels only one flight, so 10 clones need 50 verified jobs and 1,100 POA of fresh work. One sparrow flies one path for one identity and cannot be re-flown across clones.
